{{Quotation|game|For travelers into the [[Crystal Desert|desert]], this tiny harbor represents a last chance to rest and resupply. It also provides one last view of water, sight of which becomes increasingly rare as one ventures eastward.}}

[[The Amnoon Oasis]] is the [[town]] and port of the Crystal Desert. 

==Getting there==
Completion of the [[Sanctum Cay]] mission is the only way to get here.
